data.title: Software Test (QA) Automation Engineer - Mandatory Internship (Unpaid)
data.description:
About Occibo

Occibo is an AI-powered SaaS platform for children's book creation, built by IndieKidz GmbH in Berlin. We're a small, remote-first team looking for a QA intern to help us build and maintain automated testing so we can ship new features quickly and with confidence.

Internship type

Mandatory internship as part of your degree program.
This internship is unpaid.

Tasks

What you'll do

● Build end-to-end UI test automation for the Occibo web app

● Write test plans, test cases, and regression suites for core user flows

● Translate product requirements into automated checks, including edge cases

● Collaborate with the development team on test data strategies and stable selectors

● Run tests in CI, track failures, and help keep the test suite reliable

● Use AI tools to speed up test creation, analysis, and maintenance

Tools you might work with

Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Jest, Vitest, GitHub Actions

Requirements

What we're looking for

● Currently enrolled in CS, Software Engineering, or a related field

● Experience with at least one test automation framework (Playwright or Cypress preferred)

● Comfortable with JavaScript or TypeScript and Git

● Understanding of CI pipelines and reliable test design

● Interest in AI and experience using AI tools

● Fluent English

Benefits

● Hands-on experience with a real product, not a classroom exercise

● Direct collaboration with the founder and development team

● A portfolio of shipped QA work you can show future employers

Nice to have

● Prior SaaS UI automation experience

● API testing experience (Postman or REST clients)

● Based in Berlin and able to join onsite occasionally

How to apply

Send a message with your CV, short note/cover letter(preferred), your best project link, the test framework you know, and your availability and start date.

We are looking for candidates available to start in October 2026.

data.title: Senior Software Entwickler:in
data.description:
Wir sind schulz codes: sechs Leute, remote-first, zuhause in Darmstadt. Wir gehen in die Entwicklungsteams von Konzernen und Produktfirmen, damit sie danach schneller und verlässlicher liefern.

Nicht als ein Entwickler mehr im Projekt, sondern als die Leute, die den Output vom ganzen Team hochziehen. Das geht nur, wenn wir richtig gut sind; deshalb suchen wir auch nicht schnell, sondern genau.

Die Rolle in einem Satz: Du gehst mit uns in ein Kundenteam, baust dort mit und bist der Mensch, an dem die technischen Fragen hängenbleiben.

Drei Dinge bekommst du hier, und die meinen wir wörtlich.

  • Ownership. Du entscheidest selbst über Architektur mit, sprichst selbst mit den Fachbereichen und stehst dann auch für das, was du entschieden hast. Dauer-Überstunden gehören da ausdrücklich nicht dazu: War eine Woche fordernd, wird die nächste kürzer.
  • Wirksamkeit. Du wirst nicht daran gemessen, wie viele Tickets du zumachst, sondern daran, was das Team um dich herum ein halbes Jahr später kann. Und du siehst das auch, dafür sind wir klein genug.
  • Und wenn dir was nicht passt, sagst du es und änderst es. Bei uns genauso wie beim Kunden. Das ist hier kein Mut, sondern der Job.
  • Das ist eine Senior-Rolle in der Lieferung. Du führst kein Team und wir hängen dir auch keinen Lead-Titel als Karotte vor die Nase. Was du bekommst, ist echte technische Verantwortung, direkter Kundenkontakt und Zeit, richtig gut zu werden.

Aufgaben

  • Ganze Features und Epics verantworten, von der Konzeption bis ins Deployment
  • Dich schnell in fremden Codebasen zurechtfinden und das Gesamtsystem über Backend, Frontend, Infrastruktur und Schnittstellen hinweg sehen
  • Selbst mit den Fachbereichen sprechen, über Architektur entscheiden und dafür geradestehen
  • Integrations- und Skalierungsthemen früh auf den Tisch legen, nicht erst kurz vor dem Release
  • Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Blocker sichtbar machen, kleine Proof-of-Concepts bauen, wenn eine technische Frage anders nicht zu klären ist
  • So schätzen, dass die Unsicherheit mit drinsteht: nicht „fünf Tage", sondern „fünf Tage, Risiko: die API-Spezifikation ist noch unklar"
  • Das Team mitziehen: Pairing, Reviews mit Lerneffekt, Onboarding, Standards und Konventionen, die auch nach dir noch halten

Qualifikation

  • Rund sechs bis acht Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mehrere Jahre Backend in TypeScript/Node.js in Produktion
  • Architektur selbst verantwortet, nicht nur umgesetzt: Domain-Driven Design, hexagonale Architektur, modularer Monolith sind Entscheidungen, die du getroffen und dann auch ausgehalten hast
  • Entscheidungen auch dann treffen, wenn die Anforderungen noch wackeln
  • Saubere Modellierung von Fachdomänen
  • Cloud auf Architektur-Ebene, mit bewusster Auswahl der Dienste (AWS, Azure und GCP sind uns gleichwertig)
  • React zuverlässig liefern, ohne Frontend-Spezialist zu sein
  • Tests schreiben, Reviews vorleben
  • Ab Woche eins produktiv in einer fremden Codebase
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, weil du direkt mit deutschen Fachbereichen sprichst

Was uns mehr interessiert als dein Stack

  • Fachlich passende Leute gibt es viele, die Rolle entscheidet sich am Menschen. Drei Dinge müssen bei dir da sein.
  • Lernen als innere Notwendigkeit. Nicht „hab ich gelernt, weil das Projekt es gebraucht hat", sondern der echte Drang zu verstehen und vorne mitzugestalten. AI ist dafür gerade das beste Beispiel: sie soll dich verstärken, damit du weiter kommst und mehr baust, aber dein eigenes Verstehen nie ersetzen.
  • Der Antrieb, das Arbeiten für alle besser zu machen. Nicht nur den eigenen Fortschritt, sondern Team und Kunde spürbar weiterbringen. Menschen um dich herum heben, echte Verbindung aufbauen. Daraus entsteht Vertrauen, und Vertrauen ist bei uns die Grundlage von allem.
  • Ownership, und zwar so wie wir es meinen. Starke Verantwortung für deine Arbeit und ein Stück darüber hinaus, aber ausdrücklich keine Dauer-Überstunden. In der Zeit, die wir uns vornehmen, geben wir unser Bestes, und danach ist Feierabend.
  • Dazu unser härtestes Kriterium: du musst bereit sein, dich auf unsere Arbeitsweise einzulassen. Wir sind sehr offen für deine Ideen und ändern gerne Dinge, aber „so kenne ich das, kommt damit klar" funktioniert hier nicht.

Wann wir nicht zusammenpassen

  • Wenn dich vor allem Gehalt und Titel treiben
  • Wenn du deine Arbeitsweise durchdrücken willst, statt erstmal zu verstehen
  • Wenn dir die Regel wichtiger ist als die Wirkung beim Kunden
  • Wenn du AI benutzt, um dich aus dem Verstehen rauszunehmen

Benefits

  • Ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld mit spannenden Projekten und modernen Technologien.
  • Individuelle Weiterbildung durch Konferenzen, Workshops und interne Wissensaustausche.
  • Remote-first
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Mitgestaltungs-Spielraum, dein Wort zählt
  • Eine Vielzahl an Benefits
  • kurzer Draht zum Geschäftsführer - regelmäßig 1:1, keine Ebene dazwischen
  • Ein starkes leistungsorientiertes Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und voneinander lernt.

data.title: Partnership Manager (m/w/d) - Healthcare (Krankenkassen)
data.description:
Dein Impact

7Mind ist Teil der 7NXT Health Group und eine der führenden Plattformen für Meditation, Achtsamkeit und Prävention im deutschsprachigen Raum.

Die Position ist bei 7Mind angesiedelt, du arbeitest jedoch mit dem gesamten Portfolio der 7NXT Health Group, einschließlich Gymondo. Dein Ziel ist es, unser Healthcare-Geschäft auszubauen, neue Partnerschaften insbesondere im GKV- und PKV-Umfeld zu gewinnen und bestehende Partner nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln.

Dabei bringst du die Perspektive unserer Partner und Entwicklungen im Healthcare-Markt aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte und Angebote ein.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

  • Neue Partnerschaften gewinnen: Du identifizierst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im GKV- und PKV-Markt und entwickelst daraus langfristige Partnerschaften.
  • Netzwerk ausbauen: Du bringst idealerweise ein relevantes Healthcare-Netzwerk mit und baust Beziehungen zu Entscheider und Multiplikator gezielt weiter aus.
  • Partner entwickeln: Du betreust bestehende Partner strategisch und operativ und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit kontinuierlich weiter.
  • 7NXT-Portfolio nutzen: Du denkst markenübergreifend und entwickelst passende Lösungen aus dem Portfolio von 7Mind, Gymondo und der 7NXT Health Group.
  • Marktchancen nutzen: Du beobachtest Trends und regulatorische Veränderungen, identifizierst neue Chancen und bringst diese in unsere Geschäfts- und Produktentwicklung ein.
  • Produkte weiterentwickeln: Du übersetzt Partnerbedürfnisse und Marktanforderungen in konkrete Impulse für unsere Produkte und arbeitest dafür eng mit Produkt und Marketing zusammen.

Qualifikation

Deine Story

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Business Development, Sales, Partnerships oder Key Account Management im Healthcare-Umfeld, idealerweise mit GKV- und/oder PKV-Bezug.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Gewinnung und Entwicklung strategischer Partnerschaften und im Aufbau nachhaltiger Kundenbeziehungen.
  • Ein bestehendes Netzwerk im GKV-/PKV-Umfeld ist ein starkes Plus; alternativ hast du Erfahrung darin, relevante Netzwerke erfolgreich aufzubauen.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen, Marktmechanismen und Entscheidungsprozesse im deutschen Gesundheitswesen.
  • Erfahrung darin, Markt- und Kundenbedürfnisse zu erkennen und in Produkt- und Geschäftschancen zu übersetzen.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken, Verhandlungsgeschick sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Beziehungsstärke.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung, da du eng mit Partnern im deutschen Gesundheitswesen arbeitest.
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, da Englisch unsere interne Kommunikations- und Arbeitssprache innerhalb der 7NXT Health Group ist.

Benefits

Erfolg braucht gute Energie. Deshalb sorgen wir für die richtigen Rahmenbedingungen — körperlich, mental und im Team:

  • 🏖️ 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr + Heiligabend & Silvester als zusätzliche bezahlte freie Tage
  • 🏠 Hybrides Arbeitsmodell — 60% im Office, 40% von zuhause, gültig für alle Arbeitszeiten
  • 🌍 Bis zu 4 Wochen Work from Abroad pro Jahr (für Berlin-basierte Rollen)
  • 🏋️ Kostenlose Urban Sports Club M Mitgliedschaft & Zugang zu Nilo Health für mentale Gesundheit und persönliche Entwicklung
  • 📱 Kostenloser Zugang zu 7Mind, Gymondo & Buddyfit — unsere eigenen digitalen Wellbeing-Produkte
  • 🚲 30 € monatliches Mobilitätsbudget via Navit
  • 📚 1.000 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget + vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Familienfreundliche Benefits — Betreuungskosten & bezahlte Kinderkranktage
  • 🍎 Die Office-Klassiker — Obst- & Gemüsekorb, Müsli & Joghurt (auch vegan), Getränke & Snacks
  • 🐶 Tierfreundliches Office — Vierbeiner sind herzlich willkommen!

Diese Benefits gelten für Vollzeit- und Teilzeit-Festanstellungen. Werkstudent:innen und Praktikant:innen erhalten eine anteilige Auswahl.

Come as you are

Wir feiern Unterschiede und das meinen wir ernst.

Bei 7NXT, Gymondo und 7Mind setzen wir auf Vielfalt, Offenheit und Teamgeist. Ganz gleich, mit welchem Geschlecht du dich identifizierst, ob du eine Behinderung hast, was dein Neurotyp ist, woher du kommst, woran du glaubst oder wie du liebst - du bist bei uns willkommen.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Kriterien? Kein Problem. Wenn du Lust hast, mit uns die Zukunft von Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden zu gestalten, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Du brauchst einen barrierearmen Bewerbungsprozess oder hast Fragen zum Ablauf? Schreib uns und wir finden einen Weg.

Über uns

7Mind ist die bekannteste App für Achtsamkeit und mentales Wohlbefinden im deutschsprachigen Raum und Teil der 7NXT Health Group. Gemeinsam mit Gymondo und 7NXT Brand Solutions verfolgen wir eine gemeinsame Mission: We empower people to lead a fit and healthy life.

Was uns bei 7Mind besonders macht: Wir leben, was wir vermitteln. Vertrauen, Offenheit und echte Achtsamkeit prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit. Wir geben einander den Raum, den es braucht, um kreativ, fokussiert und im eigenen Tempo zu wachsen. Ob Meditation in der Mittagspause, ehrliches Feedback oder neugierige Fragen. Wir glauben daran, dass mentale Gesundheit bei uns selbst beginnt.

Unsere Nutzer:innen stehen im Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun. Wir entwickeln unsere Plattform mit Herz, wissenschaftlichem Anspruch und dem Ziel, mentale Gesundheit zugänglich, alltagstauglich und nachhaltig zu gestalten. Diversität, Inklusion und Nachhaltigkeit sind dabei für uns keine Schlagworte, sondern gelebte Haltung.

data.title: Vertriebsleiter (m/w/d)
data.description:
Werden Sie Teil eines innovativen Unternehmens und übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung und Skalierung unseres gesamten Vertriebs.

Als Vertriebsleiter / Head of Sales (m/w/d) führen Sie nicht nur unser Vertriebsteam, sondern verantworten das gesamte Vertriebsergebnis – vom eingehenden Lead über Kontakt, Beratung und Angebot bis zum profitablen Auftrag. Ihr Ziel ist es, Strukturen zu schaffen, mit denen unser Vertrieb planbar, messbar und unabhängig von einzelnen Personen erfolgreich wächst.

Dabei entwickeln Sie bestehende Prozesse weiter, etablieren klare Vertriebsstandards und KPIs, verbessern Abschlussquoten und Forecasting und entwickeln unsere Mitarbeiter durch konsequentes Coaching zu einem leistungsstarken Vertriebsteam.

Wenn Sie unternehmerisches Denken, ausgeprägte Führungskompetenz und ein tiefes Verständnis für zahlengetriebenen Vertrieb miteinander verbinden, erwartet Sie bei uns eine Schlüsselposition mit direktem Einfluss auf die weitere Unternehmensentwicklung.

und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Wachstumsphase von Premium Solarglas.

Aufgaben

  • Strategische Vertriebssteuerung: Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer klaren Vertriebsstrategie zur nachhaltigen Steigerung von Umsatz, Auftragseingang und Profitabilität.
  • Führung des Vertriebsteams: Führung, Motivation und Weiterentwicklung von Innen- und Außendienst durch klare Ziele, regelmäßiges Coaching, Call-Reviews und verbindliche Vertriebsstandards.
  • Verantwortung für den gesamten Sales Funnel: Steuerung und Optimierung des Vertriebsprozesses von Lead → Kontakt → Termin → Beratung → Angebot → Auftrag.
  • Vertriebscontrolling & KPIs: Steuerung anhand relevanter Kennzahlen wie Auftragseingang, Deckungsbeitrag, Abschlussquote, Lead-to-Termin-Rate, Show Rate, Umsatz je Verkäufer und Forecast Accuracy.
  • Forecasting & Reporting: Aufbau einer belastbaren Sales Pipeline, Erstellung realistischer Forecasts und regelmäßiges Reporting an die Geschäftsführung.
  • Prozessoptimierung & Digitalisierung: Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Vertriebsprozesse sowie Weiterentwicklung von CRM, Automatisierungen, digitalen Angeboten und Nachfassprozessen.
  • Recruiting & Mitarbeiterentwicklung: Auswahl und strukturiertes Onboarding neuer Vertriebsmitarbeiter sowie gezielte Weiterentwicklung und Leistungssteuerung des bestehenden Teams.
  • Kunden- & Verkaufsqualität: Sicherstellung einer professionellen Beratung, hoher Kundenzufriedenheit und konsequenter Verkaufsqualität sowie Ausbau von Cross- und Upselling-Potenzialen.
  • Skalierung & Marktausbau: Entwicklung neuer Vertriebskanäle, Zielgruppen und Partnerschaften sowie Aufbau skalierbarer Strukturen für weiteres Unternehmenswachstum.
  • Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Marketing, Produktion, Operations, Finance und IT zur optimalen Steuerung des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses.

Ihr übergeordnetes Ziel: Sie schaffen einen planbaren, profitablen und skalierbaren Vertrieb, der durch klare Prozesse, belastbare Zahlen und ein leistungsstarkes Team nachhaltig wächst.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Führung und Weiterentwicklung größerer Vertriebsteams

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, Vertriebsleistung anhand von Zahlen, KPIs und Conversion-Raten zu analysieren und zu verbessern
  • Erfahrung mit Forecasting, Pipeline-Management und Vertriebscontrolling

Entscheidend ist für uns nicht allein die Anzahl Ihrer Berufsjahre. Wir suchen eine Führungspersönlichkeit, die anhand konkreter Ergebnisse zeigen kann, dass sie Vertrieb strukturieren, führen, messen und skalieren kann.

data.title: Business Development / New Business (m/w/d) für digitale Sponsoringformate, Köln
data.description:
Vertrauensvertrieb an Banken, Versicherer und Versorger – kein Verkauf über die eigene Person. Einstieg in Voll- oder Teilzeit, mit dem Ziel, das gesamte Neugeschäft zu verantworten.

Wir suchen keine schnellen Abschlüsse. Wir suchen die Person, die unser Neugeschäft in einigen Jahren führt und heute anfängt, sich das zu erarbeiten.

Seit 2008 entwickeln wir digitale Sponsoringformate für Banken, Versicherungen und Energieversorger. Mit vielen Kunden arbeiten wir seit Jahren zusammen, mit einigen seit über einem Jahrzehnt.

Aufgaben

Worum es geht

Kunden kommen zu uns, weil wir ihr Haus verstehen und entsprechend beraten. Bisher kam diese Beratung vor allem vom Geschäftsführer. Genau diesen Teil des Geschäfts geben wir jetzt Schritt für Schritt ab.

Du übernimmst ihn nicht über Nacht. Zu Beginn arbeitest du eng mit unserem Geschäftsführer zusammen und lernst die Beziehungen kennen, auf denen dieses Geschäft ruht. Mit der Zeit führst du sie selbst, und dein Ziel ist, über die Jahre das gesamte Neugeschäft zu verantworten und deutlich zu vergrößern. Wir suchen jemanden, der genau das sucht: nicht eine Rolle ausfüllen, sondern eine aufbauen.

Warum das anspruchsvoll ist

Vom ersten Kontakt bis zum ersten Auftrag vergehen Monate und viele Gespräche. Aufträge entstehen über Vertrauen, Fachlichkeit und Empfehlung, nie über Druck. Deine erste Anlaufstelle sitzt meist im Marketing, in der Kommunikation oder im Vorstandsstab. Du verstehst, wie in solchen Häusern tatsächlich entschieden wird, gewinnst die Menschen, die deinen Fall intern vertreten, und führst ihn durch die Gremien, bis aus Interesse ein Auftrag wird.

Deine Gesprächspartner sind erfahren und erkennen sofort, wenn jemand nur Verkaufsrhetorik abspult. Wir verkaufen nicht über die Person, die vorn steht, sondern über die Sichtbarkeit und Fachlichkeit, aus der Vertrauen wächst. Genau die baust du mit auf. Nicht jede Anfrage trägt sofort. Wer dranbleibt, gewinnt hier.

Was du mitbringst

  • Den Ehrgeiz, dieses Geschäft eines Tages allein zu führen. Diese Aussicht reizt dich, statt dich zu erschrecken.
  • Ein feines Gespür für Sprache und für Zahlen.
  • Sicherheit im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Funktionen, vom Marketing bis zum Vorstandsstab. Du durchschaust ihre internen Abläufe und findest die Kompromisse, die einen Auftrag intern tragfähig machen.
  • Den Blick für Branchenentwicklungen, aus denen du konkrete Kommunikationschancen für unsere Kunden ableitest.
  • Die Fähigkeit, aus Ansprache und Formaten Sichtbarkeit zu bauen, die Vertrauen schafft, und dich am Ergebnis zu messen.

Von Vorteil

Benefits

Du beginnst nicht auf einem leeren Blatt. Der Weg führt bis zur vollen Verantwortung für das Neugeschäft. Das ist das erklärte Ziel dieser Position, keine Aussicht zur Zier. Deine Arbeit ermöglicht digitale Mitmachformate mit gesellschaftlicher Wirkung. Einstieg in Teil- oder Vollzeit mit überwiegendem Präsenzanteil für den engen Austausch mit dem Team.

data.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - GTM Focus (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
data.description:
Build the Commercial Team Driving the Energy Transition
Most recruiting jobs are about filling vacancies.

This one is about building the team that drives the growth of one of Europe’s fastest-growing start-ups - at the intersection of AI & climate tech.

At Reonic, we're building the AI-native operating system for renewable installers. Every SDR, Account Executive, Sales Manager, and Marketing hire you make directly influences how fast we grow—and how much impact we can create.

If you love finding exceptional commercial talent, moving fast, and partnering with ambitious hiring managers, you'll fit right in.

Please note this is a full-time, on-site position based in Berlin.

What makes this role different

  • You'll own hiring across our Go-to-Market organization, with a strong focus on SDRs, Account Executives, Sales leadership, and other revenue-generating roles

  • You'll partner directly with founders and sales leaders on some of the company's highest-impact hires

  • You'll build talent pipelines before we need them—not after positions open

  • You'll have the freedom to experiment with sourcing strategies and continuously improve our recruiting engine

  • Your hires will directly influence our growth across Europe

No waiting for applications. No unnecessary processes.

Just finding exceptional commercial talent and convincing them to join a company that's changing an industry.

What you'll do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Sales, Business Development, and other GTM roles—from sourcing through onboarding

  • Proactively source exceptional SDRs, Account Executives, Sales Managers, and other commercial talent

  • Occasionally recruit for Marketing and other business roles as the company grows

  • Partner with hiring managers to define hiring strategies, interview processes, and hiring decisions

  • Deliver an outstanding candidate experience with fast, transparent communication

  • Build scalable talent pipelines for key commercial positions

  • Continuously improve how we attract, assess, and hire top GTM talent



You'll thrive here if you…

  • Have 2+ years experience recruiting commercial talent in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Know what great SDRs, Account Executives, and sales leaders look like

  • Love active sourcing and outbound recruiting

  • Prefer ownership over rigid processes

  • Move quickly without compromising hiring quality

  • Want to build teams that directly drive company revenue

  • Nice-to-have: You need to know what a fast paced sales motion look like - or even better we have worked in sales yourself



Why join now

  • Competitive compensation and strong growth opportunities

We're a well-funded VC-backed startup reshaping how the world uses energy. We work hard, move fast, and believe exceptional people build exceptional companies.

data.title: Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer - Propulsion Battery System (all genders)
data.description:
Your Mission:

As Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer – Propulsion Battery System (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements.

Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical FEA of propulsion battery packs, PDUs, and their internal components, predicting how they behave under nominal operation and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions, and flight and inertial loads.

  • Perform room-temperature and elevated-temperature analysis of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, capturing temperature-dependent material behaviour.

  • Build and correlate nonlinear models covering material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity – including cohesive-zone and VCCT delamination, composite progressive failure and damage propagation, metal plasticity and rate-dependent behaviour, crushable foam plasticity and densification, large-deformation and post-buckling response, and frictional contact with bolt pretension, including bearing behaviour at fastener holes (bearing yield, hole elongation, and bearing–bypass interaction).

  • Model the hyper-elastic and viscoelastic behaviour of potting compounds, gap fillers, foams, gaskets, seals, and thermal interface materials to predict contact pressure and interface integrity across the life of the pack.

  • Perform durability and life analysis across the differing service lives of components within the system, covering vibration-induced high-cycle fatigue (DO-160 random and sine sweep), low-cycle fatigue from ground–air–ground and charge/discharge thermal cycling, and fatigue of bonded joints, fasteners, busbars, and interconnects.

  • Assess creep and stress relaxation of seals, adhesives, polymers, potting compounds, and thermal interface materials at elevated temperature, including loss of contact pressure across a pack replacement interval.

  • Analyse thermal runaway response as a coupled thermomechanical event – pressure loads, direct impingement flow, ejecta, and heat transfer to surrounding structure and systems – working closely with the Thermal Systems team on thermal runaway CFD modelling and the resulting heat transfer boundary conditions, in support of containment and continued safe flight and landing.

  • Apply static, fatigue, and creep material property allowable (room and elevated temperature) in the substantiation of the propulsion battery pack and PDU, working to established methodologies such as CMH-17 for composites and MMPDS for metallics, and specify the allowable, material data, and test conditions required from the Materials & Processes and Test teams.

  • Automate and script analysis workflows – model generation, parametric studies, load case sweeps, and post-processing – using Python for Abaqus scripting, and develop closed-form and lower-order analysis methods in Python or MATLAB to size hardware quickly and to verify finite element results.

  • Interface closely with the Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, and Airborne Electronics teams to translate analysis results into design improvements and robust, certifiable hardware.

  • Check and release design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements, providing the stress sign-off for propulsion battery pack and PDU hardware releases.

  • Define modelling standards, assumptions, load cases, and acceptance criteria, and maintain configuration-controlled analysis models and inputs.

  • Support test planning and post-test correlation of FEA models against coupon, component, and full-scale test data.

  • Author and release certification documentation, including analysis reports and means-of-compliance evidence for structural, environmental, and thermal runaway requirements.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural/Computational Mechanics, or a related field; a PhD in a relevant area is beneficial.

  • 5+ years of experience in structural/stress and thermomechanical FEA, preferably in aerospace, automotive, battery systems, or other high-performance engineering environments.

  • Experience taking analytical responsibility for hardware, including checking the work of others and providing stress sign-off or equivalent release approval within a configuration-controlled environment, is desirable.

  • Strong command of nonlinear FEA across material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity, with depth in several of the following: cohesive-zone modeling with traction–separation, composite progressive failure (e.g., Hashin/Puck), metal plasticity and viscoplasticity, hyperelastic and viscoelastic materials, crushable foam plasticity, large-deformation and buckling, and frictional contact with pretension, including fastener bearing and bearing–bypass analysis.

  • Experience with room-temperature and elevated-temperature modeling of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, covering temperature-dependent material behavior.

  • Experience in fatigue and damage-tolerance analysis (S–N/ε–N methods, cumulative damage, random-vibration/PSD fatigue) and in creep and stress-relaxation behavior of adhesives and polymers at elevated temperature.

  • Experience with explicit dynamics and impact/blast-type events (e.g., burst-disk actuation, vent impingement, ejecta and debris containment) is desirable.

  • Proficiency with FEA software, ideally Abaqus; experience with tools such as Ansys (Mechanical/LS-DYNA), MSC/NX Nastran, Altair (HyperMesh/OptiStruct/Radioss), or COMSOL is beneficial.

  • Experience implementing user-defined material models and subroutines in Abaqus (UMAT/VUMAT/UMATHT), including the ability to write and debug Fortran, is desirable.

  • Proficiency in scripting: Python for Abaqus automation and post-processing, and Python or MATLAB for closed-form and lower-order analysis methods used to size hardware and verify finite element results.

  • Proficiency with 3D CAD, ideally SolidWorks or CATIA, is desirable; experience with Siemens NX is beneficial.

  • Experience applying static, fatigue, and creep material property allowables to the substantiation of structural hardware, including familiarity with CMH-17 and MMPDS methodologies or equivalent, and with A-/B-basis statistical allowables.

  • Familiarity with aerospace environmental and structural requirements, in particular DO-160 environmental conditions and CS-23 structural substantiation, is desirable.

  • Working knowledge of propulsion battery thermal runaway means of compliance, including DO-311A and the ANAC–EASA–FAA–TCCA harmonized thermal runaway white paper for propulsion batteries, is beneficial.

  • Familiarity with development assurance and safety processes (e.g., ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/4761A, and ASTM F3230 for small aircraft) is beneficial.

  • Experience with battery systems or electric propulsion systems is beneficial.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and attention to detail.

data.title: Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders)
data.description:
Your Mission:

We are developing a next-generation electric aircraft propulsion system, with the propulsion battery designed, developed, and validated in-house. Accurate real-time observation and prediction of the battery’s State of Function (SoF), the energy and power actually accessible for safe flight and landing, is the safety-critical output of the battery system, and the basis for pre-flight planning, in-flight energy management, and the energy information presented to the crew.

SoF is built on the underlying battery states that your algorithms observe and predict: state of charge (SoC), state of health (SoH), state of power (SoP), state of energy (SoE), and state of balance (SoB). Erroneous observation or prediction of SoF is classified as a catastrophic condition, since it can lead the crew to commit to a flight or an approach the battery cannot support. This makes the function certification-critical and places exacting demands on the accuracy, robustness, and verifiability of every algorithm you deliver.

As a Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders), you will join the VÆRIDION Technology team and take ownership of the development and validation of the state observers, estimators, and predictors that determine SoF for our lithium-ion propulsion battery systems.

This is a hands-on senior role in which you lead the modeling, simulation, algorithm development, test-data analysis, and validation behind these states, and set the methodology the team works to.

Your work will shape the high-voltage battery system at the center of VÆRIDION’s electric propulsion architecture and carry it through to certification.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Own the end-to-end development and validation of battery state observers, estimators, and predictors for SoF, SoC, SoH, SoP, SoE, and SoB across cell, cell-bank, and pack level

  • Parameterize multi-RC equivalent-circuit models (OCV, R0, RC pairs, hysteresis, thermal, and aging effects) from cell supplier data, virtual and physical test benches, and HiL rigs

  • Design, implement, and validate estimation algorithms such as Kalman filters (EKF/UKF/dual-UKF/SKF), particle filters, observers, and data-driven/ML methods, while respecting the certification limitations of ML-based approaches

  • Develop mission-aware predictors that ingest flight-profile and navigation data to predict SoF until safe landing, and compute the energy margin, the predicted surplus SoF at destination, and the SoF trend presented to the crew, updating on diversion, altitude, speed, and ambient changes

  • Develop aging and degradation models and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction, and validate the SoH algorithm against the applicable end-of-life criteria across representative mission and durability profiles

  • Ensure the algorithms align with ED-289 requirements for state observers and predictors and ED-309 methodologies for energy level information to the crew, and are consistent with the “Manage Energy” functional breakdown

  • Ensure the algorithms meet functional-safety expectations for a DAL B function: deterministic and bounded execution time, reproducibility, uncertainty bounds on outputs, plausibility checks, built-in test, and malfunction and fault detection

  • Derive, document, and trace algorithm requirements from ED-289/ED-309 and system-level functional analysis, and maintain traceability into the real-time battery management software specification using a model-based design approach

  • Support the real-time embedded realization of estimators and predictors on the pack, lane, and central control units (fixed-point implementation, Simulink code generation, MISRA C) and validate them on HiL setups

  • Define the test and analysis strategy for virtual and physical battery test benches and HiL rigs, and analyze cell, cell-bank, and pack-level data to evaluate algorithm accuracy, stability, and robustness across temperature, aging, and usage variability

  • Set the standard for documentation of methods, assumptions, and validation results

  • Lead collaboration with cell engineering, BMS software, test, HV/LV electrical systems, and certification teams

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Control Engineering, or a related field

  • 5+ years of professional experience in battery state estimation, control systems, or embedded algorithm development

  • Strong command of state estimation and control theory: Kalman filtering (EKF/UKF/dual-UKF/SKF), particle filters, observers, and system modeling, with an awareness of data-driven and ML methods and their certification constraints

  • Solid battery domain knowledge: lithium-ion electrochemistry, equivalent-circuit and thermal models, aging and degradation mechanisms (capacity fade, resistance growth, lithium plating), OCV hysteresis, and cell-bank-level state granularity

  • Proficiency in Matlab/Simulink and Python, with familiarity with C/C++, fixed-point implementation, Git, and CI/CD

  • Experience with real-time simulation, HiL testing, and embedded systems

  • Familiarity with aerospace functional safety and certification: DO-178C/ED-12C and the DAL concept, requirements-based verification and validation, MBSE and model-based design, and relevant battery and energy standards (ED-289, ED-309, DO-311A, SAE AIR6897); DO-160 environmental awareness is a plus

data.title: (Senior) Flight Control System Engineer (all genders)
data.description:
Your Mission:

We are seeking a (Senior) Flight Control System Engineer (all genders) to lead the design and development of the flight control systems for our battery-electric aircraft. In this role, you will be responsible for defining and integrating the aircraft’s primary and secondary flight control systems, including both mechanical and electrically actuated elements, working in close collaboration with the flight physics, structures, and systems teams. You will drive the flight control system throughout its complete development lifecycle, from system-level requirements definition through architecture development, preliminary and detailed design, supplier coordination, integration, verification and validation activities, and ultimately system and aircraft certification. Working cross-functionally with structures, avionics, flight physics, systems, and overall aircraft design, you will ensure robust integration of the flight control system within the aircraft. As a senior engineer, you will play a central role in technical decision-making, system trade-offs, and the maturation of the overall aircraft configuration.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define, derive, and manage system-level requirements for the flight control system, ensuring alignment with aircraft-level requirements, program objectives, and applicable certification regulations (CS-23 and related operational requirements).

  • Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition, architecture definition, interface identification, and traceability management.

  • Lead the detailed definition, development, and integration of the flight control system, covering installation design, kinematics, load paths, performance, reliability, maintainability, and safety considerations.

  • Own the technical coordination and oversight of suppliers and development partners, including requirement allocation, design reviews, verification activities, and compliance demonstration.

  • Support and contribute to system safety activities related to flight controls, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA/SFHA), Preliminary System Safety Assessments (PSSA), and Zonal Safety Analysis,in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards.

  • Actively contribute to the design implementation and configuration control of the flight control system within the aircraft Digital Mock-Up (DMU), ensuring proper integration with structures and other aircraft systems.

  • Support the flight controls certification process, including preparation and review of certification plans, compliance checklists, qualification documentation and execution, and participation in ground and flight test campaigns.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering or Mechanical Engineering(or equivalent).

  • Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in the development of mechanically actuated aircraft flight control systems, preferably within Part 23aircraftprogramsoperatingunder a DOA environment or international equivalent.

  • Strong background in systems engineering applied to flight controls, including requirement capture and management, functional decomposition, interface definition, and traceability.

  • Demonstrated expertise in the design, integration, assembly, and testing of mechanical primary flight control systems, including kinematics, load transmission, tolerance management, friction and free-play control, and troubleshooting during ground and flight test campaigns.

  • Proven experience across the full product development lifecycle, from conceptual architecture and preliminary design through detailed design, verification, validation, and certification (Part 23 or Part 25).

data.title: PCB Layout Engineer / Leiterplattenentwickler:in (all genders)
data.description:
Your Mission:

Join VÆRIDION on our journey to develop the world's first electric nine-seater aircraft. As a PCB Layout Engineer (all genders) in our Technology division, you will own the physical design of the printed circuit boards at the heart of our high-voltage propulsion battery and power-distribution systems, turning engineering intent into flight-ready, manufacturable and certifiable hardware. Partnering closely with our electronics, hardware and manufacturing engineers from schematic to fabrication, you will apply IPC standards and aerospace-grade design discipline to hardware that must be safe, reliable and light enough to fly - work that directly underpins the propulsion battery system at the core of our mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Design, route and iterate multilayer PCB layouts from schematics, netlists and engineering requirements.

  • Define and document PCB stack-ups, controlled-impedance geometries and reference-plane strategies together with the hardware engineers.

  • Perform ECAD–MCAD co-design with the mechanical team, including STEP exchange, board-outline and keep-out definition, and connector and component placement against enclosure and thermal constraints.

  • Apply high-voltage layout discipline - creepage and clearance, isolation barriers and 3W spacing - in line with IPC-2221 and the demands of aerospace high-voltage battery systems.

  • Engineer for signal integrity, power integrity, EMI/EMC, manufacturability and thermal management, using thermal vias, heavy-copper and metal-clad constructions.

  • Create and govern the PCB component library — schematic symbols, footprints and 3D models - in accordance with IPC standards.

  • Ensure designs comply with IPC-2221, IPC-7351 and IPC-6012 (including Class 3 expectations for high-reliability hardware) and other relevant IPC standards.

  • Produce complete fabrication and assembly data packages: Gerbers, ODB++/IPC-2581, drill files, BOMs, pick-and-place and assembly drawings.

  • Perform design rule checks (DRC), electrical rule checks and layout-versus-schematic verification, and support design and readiness reviews.

  • Collaborate with electronics and hardware engineers to implement design changes and resolve layout issues.

  • Partner with PCB fabricators and assemblers to resolve DFM/DFA feedback and manufacturing topics, and to qualify new suppliers and processes.

  • Maintain rigorous revision control, configuration management and technical documentation across the hardware baseline.

 

Your Profile:

  • Diploma, associate degree or vocational qualification in Electronics, Electrical Engineering Technology or a related field.

  • Minimum of five years of hands-on experience in PCB layout or electronics design support.

  • Proven proficiency with a professional ECAD tool such as Altium Designer (preferred), OrCAD/Allegro, Zuken, Eagle, KiCad or similar.

  • Strong working knowledge of IPC PCB design, fabrication and assembly standards, and the ability to read and interpret electrical schematics.

  • Solid understanding of multilayer stack-up design, controlled impedance and PCB manufacturing technologies (rigid, flex, rigid-flex, hybrid, thick-copper, metal-clad).

  • High attention to detail, disciplined documentation and configuration-control habits, and the ability to manage several boards and deadlines in parallel.

  • Effective communication and teamwork skills in an English-speaking, cross-functional engineering environment.

  • IPC certification such as IPC CID or CID+ is a plus.

  • Experience with high-voltage, high-power, high-speed, HDI (microvias, blind/buried vias) or mixed-signal PCBs is a plus.

  • Experience designing to high-reliability or Class 3 requirements, and familiarity with aerospace standards such as RTCA DO-160 (environmental) and RTCA DO-254 (airborne electronic hardware), are a plus.

  • Exposure to signal-integrity / power-integrity simulation and close collaboration with hardware engineers on SI/PI is a plus.

  • Familiarity with quality and compliance requirements in regulated industries (aerospace, automotive, medical or similar) is a plus.

  • Awareness of thermal-management and mechanical co-design for compact, vibration- and temperature-exposed hardware is a plus.

data.description:
Build the Future of Climate Tech with Phlair

We're solving humanity's biggest challenge, and it takes everything we've got.

The world needs more energy, not less. Fossil fuels powered our economy for decades, at the cost of our planet. At Phlair, we're inverting that equation with breakthrough electrochemical Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology that pulls CO₂ from the air for permanent storage or repurposing into carbon-negative chemicals.

We're not here to play it safe. We're here to win.

Why We’re Different?

We solve hard problems and are product-first. Our hydrolyzer-based Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology, enabling scalable and low-cost CO2 capture from ambient air. The electrochemical technology allows off-the-shelf components and is ideally suited to the intermittent nature of renewable energy sources.

With proven offtake agreements from customers such as Google, McKinsey, JPMorganChase, Shopify, Stripe, H&M, and Deep Sky; we're one of only seven DAC companies with real market validation.

Project Dawn isn't just our flagship; it's our shot to scale CO₂ removal globally.

Is this a fit for me?

We're building for the 3-5% who are energized by winning and thrive under pressure. Our pace demands people who see excellence as non-negotiable and execution as everything. We cherish work-life-harmony, not balance. If you need extensive structure or prefer playing it safe, we're probably not the right fit.

Don't tick every box? We value potential and spikes over perfect resumes. If you believe you can contribute to our mission at this intensity level, tell us why.

As a Growth & Operations Intern, you support Phlair’s commercial and go-to-market efforts across customer research, pipeline development, and strategic analysis. You work closely with the commercial team, CEO, and technical teams to help turn technology progress into real market traction.

This role is ideal if you want to understand how deep-tech climate companies sell, position themselves, and navigate regulation-driven markets.

  • Help structure and maintain CRM data, sales funnels, and market intelligence

This is not a “shadowing” internship. You’ll do real work that matters.

What You Bring

  • Strong interest in climate tech, carbon removal, energy, or industrial decarbonization

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools and automation workflows, or strong curiosity to apply AI in commercial and operational contexts

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to structure information and communicate clearly in writing and presentations

  • High ownership mentality, reliability, and comfort working in a fast-moving, unstructured environment

data.description:
Location: Munich
Start: Immediately
Duration: 3-6 months
Type: Full-time internship / Part-Time Working Student

Please note: This role requires native-level American English

Bliro is exploring the US market, and we're looking for someone to lead our very first outbound efforts there - from Munich. Whether you're an exchange student, intern, or just here for a semester abroad - this is a high-ownership, high-visibility role: you'll be talking directly to American prospects every day, and the pipeline you build will shape one of the biggest decisions Bliro makes this year.

About Bliro

At Bliro, we're revolutionizing the daily work of sales teams with AI. 2.5 million field sales reps in Germany alone lose hours every day to manual follow-up work. Bliro solves exactly that problem - with proprietary AI technology developed at TU Munich and funded by the Federal Ministry of Economics and the EU Commission, which transcribes and analyzes customer conversations in real time, whether online or in person. This allows teams worldwide to make data-driven decisions and automate their processes.

Today, more than 2,000 companies already trust Bliro - including fast-growing startups, established corporates, and mid-sized companies (e.g. igus, Lanxess, and Telefónica Deutschland). Backed by top investors, we're now looking for a motivated Sales (SDR) intern to help drive our growth even further.

Our sales team brings experience from the fastest-growing software companies in the world (ex-Deel, ex-Autodesk, ex-Celonis) as well as their own startup founding experience!

👇 See for yourself what you'll be selling to sales teams:

Sounds like the future? It is. And you can help shape it!

🎯 Your Responsibilities

  1. Own outbound prospecting into the US market - research, cold-call, and open conversations with potential customers by phone, email, and LinkedIn.

  2. Qualify leads rigorously, distinguishing genuine buying interest from polite enthusiasm - you'll need good instincts for reading US business conversations specifically.

  3. Book and manage a pipeline of introductory calls and demos.

  4. Work closely with founders and the Account Executive team to shape how we position Bliro for American prospects.

  5. Bring structure to a brand-new motion - there's no existing playbook here, so your feedback on what works will directly influence our approach.

  6. Support a leadership visit to the US to meet prospects in person, helping prepare briefings and scheduling.

🧠 Your Profile

We're not looking for finished professionals - we're looking for doers with passion and curiosity.

What you should bring:

  • Native or near-native American English speaker, with genuine fluency in US business communication norms and small talk.

  • Confident and natural on the phone - you can build rapport with a stranger quickly.

  • Currently a student (any field) or in a gap year, based in or able to work from Munich for the duration of the role.

  • Resilient and self-motivated - comfortable with high call volume and undeterred by rejection.

Nice to have, but not required:

  • Prior experience in outbound sales (e.g. internships, working student jobs, part-time jobs)

  • Experience with tools like HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or other outreach tools

  • Working German sufficient to collaborate day-to-day with the Munich team (native German not required).

💡 Why Bliro

💸 Compensation + perks worth mentioning
This isn't an "internship for experience" - you'll get a fair salary, an uncapped variable bonus (yes, even as an intern), a Deutschlandticket, Wellpass, and food and drinks in the office. Your effort gets rewarded. Learning budget? We've got it. Sales library? Of course. Personal coaching? Included too

🌍 20 people, 9 countries, one network
Here you'll meet creativity and internationality. You'll work with people who think along with you, laugh with you, and want to grow with you. Our team also brings experience from the fastest-growing software companies in the world. On top of that, you'll benefit from our strong network in Munich's startup ecosystem - with connections to VCs and founders.

📍 An office location that's hard to beat

Our office sits right above the Augustiner Stammhaus - right in the heart of Munich. Whether it's lunch with a view of the city or a quick after-work beer around the corner: you won't find a better neighborhood.

🥳 Real team spirit, every month

We don't wait for the annual offsite. At Bliro, there are monthly team events - from mini golf and bowling to burrito nights and pickleball. Spontaneous lunches and coffee breaks included.

🧑‍💻 Flexible
9 to 5 not your thing? No problem. Whether from your kitchen table or the office - what matters to us is the result, not the location. And yes, pajama pants are officially allowed when working from home.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 You'll never pitch alone
Your start at Bliro will be accompanied by a buddy who onboards you, catches you when needed, and keeps you supplied with memes. We're team players - from day one to your first successful demo (and beyond).

Do you want to experience and help shape the sales side of an AI startup from the ground up? Then apply now!

Let's build the future of Sales - together. 💥

You will play a key role towards achieving new business pipeline, upsell pipeline and renewals targets across DACH.

What You'll Do

  • Build and grow Legora's brand presence across DACH, ensuring Legora shows up wherever our customers are with consistent positioning and messaging across all regional marketing activities.

data.title: SCADA Engineering Manager (m/f/d) – Utility Scale PV & BESS
data.description:
Overview

As SCADA Engineering Manager, you take technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems for our utility-scale PV and BESS projects. You act as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and external suppliers such as Gantner or meteocontrol — ensuring these systems are correctly specified, integrated, tested and commissioned.

This role combines strong technical understanding with coordination and stakeholder management: you translate between grid operator requirements, customer expectations, supplier solutions and EPC project realities. 
Most importantly, when a plant reaches commissioning, you ensure SCADA, PPC and communication systems work reliably — rather than becoming the project's last unresolved interface.


Your mission

  • Technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems
  • Supplier management — coordinating SCADA/PPC providers (e.g. Gantner, meteocontrol) and holding them accountable for correct specification, integration and delivery
  • Acting as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and suppliers
  • Testing & commissioning oversight for SCADA, PPC and communication systems
  • Engineering & project coordination across the full plant lifecycle


Your profile

  • Degree in electrical engineering, automation engineering, control engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
  • Several years of professional experience in SCADA, industrial automation, power plant control, renewable energy, or grid integration
  • Experience with utility-scale PV, BESS, substations, or other power generation assets highly desirable
  • Good understanding of SCADA architectures, industrial communication networks, and plant control systems
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, OPC UA or comparable
  • Understanding of active power, reactive power, voltage and grid control concepts is an advantage
  • Experience working with grid operators, utilities, or grid compliance requirements highly desirable
  • Proven track record coordinating external technical suppliers and managing complex system interfaces
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across hardware, software and communication systems
  • Confident communicator with engineers, customers, suppliers and grid operators
  • Structured working style and a strong ownership mentality — you drive technical topics until resolved
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites, suppliers or customers
  • Driving licence category B
  • Fluent English; German language skills strongly preferred
  • A responsible, proactive and solution-oriented approach to work, with the ability to apply professional expertise effectively in day-to-day activities
  • A commitment to respectful, trusting collaboration and mutual support within the team


What we offer

 

  • Work in a growing, international company with a start-up mindset
  • A workplace in a central location in Saarbrücken with good transport links
  • An open and friendly working atmosphere
  • Flexitime scheme with core working hours
  • Company sports programme (Hansefit)
  • Subsidised parking in the city centre or a travel allowance for public transport
  • JobRad

data.description:
Deine Rolle bei Karriere Tutor

Karriere Tutor steht für moderne, praxisnahe Weiterbildung und Umschulung – und für eine Lernkultur, die Menschen stark macht. Du möchtest mit deinem Know-how und deiner Persönlichkeit etwas bewegen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und begleite unsere Teilnehmenden in ihrer persönlichen Entwicklung.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, Verlässlichkeit, Empathie und eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.  
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. 
Das wäre ein Plus:
  • Erfahrung in der Erwachsenenbildung oder beruflichen Weiterbildung.  
  • AEVO-Schein (AdA), Train the Trainer oder eine vergleichbare berufspädagogische Qualifikation.  
  • Erfahrung mit Python, Data Analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning, BI oder generativer AI.  


Unsere Benefits für dich

  • Work & Travel: Verbinde deinen Job mit Reisen – bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr remote aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub: Ob du die Welt bereisen, Abenteuer erleben oder dich einfach erholen möchtest – wir geben dir den Freiraum dafür.

  • Zukunftsorientiert: Wir sichern dich ab – von betrieblicher Altersvorsorge bis zum Kindergartenzuschuss. Wir denken heute schon an übermorgen für dich und deine Familie!
  • Corporate Benefits: Auf der Suche nach dem nächsten Deal? Bei uns bekommst du zahlreiche Vergünstigungen und exklusive Angebote.


Hier wirst du gebraucht

Wir freuen uns auf deine Unterstützung an unseren Umschulungsstandorten in Augsburg, Braunschweig, Bremen, Köln, Leipzig und München. Teile uns deinen bevorzugten Arbeitsort einfach im Rahmen deiner Bewerbung mit!

data.title: Data Engineer (f/m/d)
data.description:
Job description

We are currently seeking a Data Engineer for our international and diverse Climate Policy Team (CPT). The team is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, the 1.5°C global warming limit and the evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects, such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is being processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.


As a Data Engineer you will play a critical role in designing, building and maintaining our data infrastructure, ensuring efficient and accurate data processing, storage and retrieval. 


Your Responsibilities

  • You will help to build and maintain a data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning data science and data engineering work.

  • Contribute to the full lifecycle of data platform development from design and deployment to continuous improvement

  • Strengthen data pipelines reliability, observability, and automation through code and tooling improvements.

  • Collaborate with data scientists and researchers to define data processing requirements.

  • Support AI/LLM initiatives across the organisation from a data and infrastructure perspective.

  • Help develop backend data services and APIs that expose curated datasets to internal and external consumers and applications.

  • Monitor, anticipate, and resolve operational or data quality issues in data pipelines. Ensure data reliability.


Relevant Tech Skills

Please note that this list is non exhaustive and that if you don’t have experience on some of those you should still apply.


Required:

  • Python

  • SQL

  • PostgreSQL

  • Object storage (like S3/Minio)

  • Containers (like Docker)

  • Git

  • CI/CD principles


Nice to have:

  • Pandas/Polar/DuckDB or other framework for data processing

  • Conda

  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana and Elasticsearch)

  • Infrastructure as code tool (like Terraform or Ansible)

  • AI‑driven productivity tools


Your profile

You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills: 

  • You have a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, ideally with a specialization in Data Engineering or DevOps, or a related field.

  • You have gained initial experience as a Data Engineer in a production environment.

  • Foundational notions in data modeling, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, optimization.

  • Familiarity with the relevant tech skills mentioned above.

  • Basic understanding of data pipelines, APIs, or backend services.

  • Exposure to data engineering in the context of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence across different types of data formats (structured vs unstructured) and processing methods.

  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).

  • A problem solver, a fixer, and a creative technologist. We believe coding is a talent and a passion, not just a skill.

  • A strong communicator and a team player who can work efficiently with others, in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international team.

  • Exceptional time management in a complex and largely autonomous work environment.

  • Good communication skills in English


Our offer

  • A job with a purpose. You will work in an international team of highly engaged people and contribute to our work in the field of climate change mitigation

  • A positive and inspiring working atmosphere in an international team. Our Berlin office is located near Moritzplatz in the heart of Kreuzberg

  • Hybrid office policy and flexible start time

  • Fully funded Germany-wide public transport ticket

  • 40 € monthly company contribution to Urban Sports Club membership

  • Online mental health and wellbeing platform

  • Free German language classes

  • Bike rental discount

  • Optional company pension plan


Conditions

  • Application deadline: Open until filled

  • Start date: As soon as possible

  • Duration: We are looking for a long-term collaboration. Currently we can offer a fixed term contract for 12 months with the perspective of extension based on performance and funding.

  • Remuneration: The range is EUR 4,363 (Masters plus 5+ relevant years outside of university studies) to EUR 4,810 (9+ years relevant experience outside of Masters'), in accordance with level 4 steps 1 to 3 of our remuneration scales

  • Vacation: 29 days paid annual leave for each year worked (pro rata) + one day gifted around Christmas.


Please apply with your CV and a cover letter addressing essential criteria, listing of three references, and include your earliest start date and salary expectations. Please use PDF format exclusively using the application form. Applications by email or by post can unfortunately not be processed.


We are a diverse and inclusive team and welcome your application regardless of your gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect that makes you unique.

About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a  New Business Director (Global ) do at WPP Production? 

The Business Director - Growth & Clients plays a pivotal role in shaping and driving growth for WPP Production: defining how we win high-value, complex opportunities, deepening our most important client relationships, and shaping the strategic direction of our growth function.

Reporting into the Global Chief Growth Officer and working closely with the Global Chief Client Officer, this is a highly strategic role, responsible for designing integrated solutions, evolving go-to-market propositions and building a repeatable growth engine that enables the business to win and grow consistently across markets, clients and opportunity types. As a member of the Senior Leadership Team, you will help set the direction of the business and represent growth and clients at a senior level.

You will lead the strategic direction and narrative for priority opportunities, ensuring that responses are clearly positioned, commercially compelling and aligned to client needs. You will be accountable for the quality and consistency of our narrative and strategic output across pitches you are leading, setting the standard for how we articulate our value. Equally, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior clients, using a deep understanding of their business and objectives to grow relationships and unlock new opportunities.

You will partner with Global Managing Partners on organic and new opportunities and the Global MD of Hex. Hex is the WPP Production Creative Technology and AI Studio specialising in generative AI, agentic AI, gaming, immersive experiences, and robotics. As part of this collaboration, you will come to understand our significant tech and tools partnerships.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will play a key role in driving integration across Media, Creative and Production, shaping how we bring together capabilities to deliver differentiated client solutions.

Beyond individual opportunities, you will take a broader view of growth, defining where we should focus, how we prioritise opportunities, and how we scale success globally. This includes evolving our approach to pitches, refining commercial models and embedding best practice ways of working across the team.

This is a high-impact, high-profile role with visibility across the business, suited to someone who thrives in complexity, operates with a high level of autonomy, and is motivated by driving measurable growth, client satisfaction and business impact at scale.

Key areas of responsibility

  • Define and lead the strategic direction for priority, high-value opportunities, ensuring a clear and differentiated approach to winning
  • Accountable for the narrative quality and strategic standard across assigned pitches, setting the benchmark for how we articulate our value
  • Design end-to-end client solutions, including operating models, pricing approach and value proposition
  • Lead on innovation in growth, including exploring the use of AI and new technologies to enhance team capability and efficiency
  • Work with the Global Chief Growth Officer to define and drive the global growth strategy for WPP Production, identifying priority markets, opportunity types and areas of focus
  • Partner with the Global Chief Client Officer to grow existing relationships, driving organic growth and cross-selling WPP Production's full breadth of capabilities and services
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior clients, providing strategic insights and guidance that help them achieve their business objectives through the right production strategy
  • Drive improved conversion, efficiency and revenue impact across the new business pipeline through stronger strategic positioning and approach
  • Support financial performance, partnering with Commercial and Finance teams on P&Ls, budgets, forecasting, contribution margins and profit levers across clients and new opportunities
  • Build and scale a repeatable growth engine, embedding frameworks, playbooks, tools and best practice that enable teams globally to win consistently without central dependency
  • Act as a "pitch doctor", stepping into critical opportunities to strengthen narrative, structure and overall response quality
  • Present and represent WPP Production in senior client meetings and pitch meetings
  • Drive cross-WPP integration, ensuring collaboration across Media, Creative and Production
  • Develop and scale team capability through coaching, mentoring and training, creating a culture of collaboration, inclusion and continuous learning

 

What good looks like (key requirements)

  • Significant experience (typically 10+ years) in new business, growth, client leadership or strategy roles within a creative, production or agency environment
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, with a proven ability to define how complex opportunities are approached and won
  • Outstanding writing and storytelling ability, with experience leading narrative development for high-value, multi-disciplinary pitches
  • Proven experience leading large, complex and high-value pitch processes, often involving multiple stakeholders and disciplines
  • Expert client relationship skills in a multi-stakeholder, matrix environment, with a track record of driving up (or turning around) client satisfaction
  • Confident and credible communicator, with experience presenting to senior clients and influencing at leadership level
  • Comfortable operating at pace and under pressure, managing multiple high-stakes opportunities simultaneously
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing ecosystems, including the intersection of media, creative, technology and production
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, bringing structure and clarity to complex challenges
  • A proactive and solutions-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Experience developing and mentoring team members, with a focus on building capability and scaling impact
  • Curious and forward-thinking, with an interest in innovation, AI and the future of content and production

 

#LI-HYBRID

#LI-RH1

 

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Please contact

data.title: Channel Account Executive (EMEA)
data.description:
Bitwarden empowers enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely store and share sensitive data. With a transparent, open-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts. 

Bitwarden is seeking a dynamic and motivated Channel AE to join our team. This role will focus primarily on fostering partnerships in EMEA. In your role, you will be responsible for managing lead flow, closing deals, recruiting partners and developing geographical go to market plans. 

This is an all remote team and we're looking for someone located in the UK who is fluent in either Spanish or Italian and English

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist the head of Channel Sales in developing partnerships in EMEA 
  • Provide quotes and pricing to partners in timely manner
  • Manage the deal registration process 
  • Responsible for targeted regions where Bitwarden has taken a channel first strategy
  • Identify and cultivate sales leads within targeted regions, feeding these opportunities to resellers as needed
  • Establish and nurture relationships with key resellers, enabling them to operate autonomously while ensuring alignment with Bitwarden's strategic goals
  • Deliver technical and sales training to emerging partnerships
  • Collaborate with marketing teams to execute joint marketing efforts that drive brand awareness and sales through channel partners
  • Conduct sales calls with partners and potential customers to support the sales process and provide product expertise
  • Establish and nurture relationships with key resellers, enabling them to operate autonomously while ensuring alignment with Bitwarden's strategic goals
  • Maintain a regional partner plan mapping partner strengths (customer relationships, vertical focus, technology specialty) to accounts and target opportunities

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • Fluency in English
  • Consistent results in a quota based role
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 2-4 years of experience in partner development,account management, or channel management, 
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with resellers
  • Self-motivated, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and a results-oriented mindset
  • Track and manage lead flow both inbound and outbound between partners and the Bitwarden Sales team. Proactively communicate with Bitwarden sales leaders on the channel pipeline and forecast
  • Work closely with marketing to deliver marketing events/programs/campaigns that create interest and awareness among partners' customers. Build and execute joint partner business plans with measurable success

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages:

  • Screening call with our Recruiting Manager
  • Interview with Hiring Manager (Head of Channel Sales)
  • Interview with our CSO
  • Interview with our Head of Sales Enablement
  • Final Interview with our CEO
  • Reference Checks

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations.
  • Become an expert in a growing market. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
  • Learn and grow professionally. Embrace the opportunity to build up your demand generation and product-led growth expertise in a fast-growing startup.
  • We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.

Rejoignez notre transformation !

 

TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes possédant une RQTH en cours de validité.

 

Vos missions :

 

Gestion administrative du personnel :

  •          Gérer les entrées et sorties : contrats de travail, avenants, attestations.

  •          Suivre les périodes d’essai, absences, congés, arrêts maladie.

  •          Assurer la mise à jour des dossiers individuels des salariés.

  •          Préparer les documents nécessaires à la vie du contrat (médecine du travail, formation, disciplinaire)

Gestion des disciplinaires :

  •          Conseiller et accompagner les managers dans la gestion des situations disciplinaires (avertissements, convocations, sanctions).

  •          Rédiger les courriers disciplinaires et suivre les procédures associées.

  •          Veiller au respect du droit du travail et de la convention collective du transport.

 

Accompagnement des managers et des équipes:

  •          Accompagner les collaborateurs dans leurs démarches RH et leur parcours professionnel.

  •          Contribuer à la prévention des conflits et à l’amélioration du climat social.

 

Communication Interne :

  •          Participer à l'élaboration et à la diffusion des supports de communication interne (intranet).
